summary: Loop AI (loopai.com), founded in 2022, is a restaurant back-office platform automating finance, marketing, and profitability tasks around third-party delivery — consolidating delivery sales into a single dashboard and using AI to scan customer reviews for issues.

Loop AI raised $14 million in a funding round (reported February 2026) to expand its AI-driven back-office platform addressing third-party delivery complexity, following an earlier $6M seed round led by Base10 Partners with Afore Capital participating.

Growing multi-unit restaurant chains use Loop's AI to optimize management of third-party delivery operations, per Food On Demand trade coverage, though specific brand names are not disclosed in the available excerpt. (Scope note: Article references unnamed 'growing chains'; no specific restaurant brand names were confirmed in the accessible excerpt.)
